title: CobbleHorizon - Pokemon [Cobblemon]
description: Welcome to the official CobbleHorizon modpack page on Modrinth! Are you a fan of both Pokémon and Minecraft? Then you're in the right place!
body:
# 🌅 COBBLEHORIZON: The Definitive Pokémon Experience

Welcome to **CobbleHorizon**, where the complexity of modern Minecraft meets the soul of the Pokémon franchise. This modpack is engineered for high-performance gameplay on our **official server**, providing a seamless bridge between technical survival and competitive monster collecting.

> **"Catch, Train, and Battle over 1,025 Pokémon across 9 Generations!"**

---

### 🛡️ Technical Excellence & Performance
* **Next-Gen Optimization:** Powered by **Sodium**, **Lithium**, and **Sodium Extra** for maximum frame rates and stability.
* **Enhanced Visuals:** Native shader support via **Iris** and improved entity textures for a stunning, immersive world.
* **Smart Navigation:** Integrated **Xaero’s Minimap** and **WorldMap** systems to track your journey across dimensions.
* **Advanced Storage:** Use **Sophisticated Backpacks** and remote PC access to manage your resources anywhere.

### ⚔️ Advanced Battle Mechanics
* **The Full Arsenal:** Master **Mega Evolution**, **Z-Moves**, **Dynamax**, and **Terastallization** in strategic combat.
* **Intelligent HUD:** Real-time catch percentages and ball effectiveness comparisons provided by **Catchrate Display**.
* **Multiplayer Raids:** Team up for **1 to 7-star Raids** to face Paradox and Legendary Pokémon for rare rewards.
* **Regional Challenges:** Custom Gyms and animated Leaders inspired by **Kanto, Johto, Hoenn, and Sinnoh**.

### 🌍 A World Built for You
* **Living Dex Ready:** Massive storage with **1,800 PC slots** and improved **Shiny odds (1:2048)**.
* **Exploration Tools:** Ride over **200 different Pokémon** to traverse the land, sea, and sky.
* **Immersive Audio:** A dynamic, reactive soundtrack that changes based on your environment and battle state.
* **Curated Gameplay:** Default settings disable hunger and hostile mobs to focus on your Pokémon journey.

---

### 📜 Integration & Credits
**CobbleHorizon** automates the integration of necessary resource packs to ensure a one-click setup. We acknowledge and thank the third-party creators whose amazing contributions make this experience possible. All original rights remain with the respective authors, and content is sourced exclusively from official repositories to ensure proper attribution.

**Choose your starter. Build your team. Become the legend of CobbleHorizon.**
